NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 10 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 15, 3:08 PM ET

Bijan Robinson is the top-projected running back on the Week 10 DraftKings main slate at 25.5 DraftKings points for $8,200, against Kansas City. Christian McCaffrey (21.0, $8,500) and Chuba Hubbard (20.8, $7,200) are next.

Emmett Johnson returns the most per dollar among running backs projected for at least 9 points: 4.42 projected points per $1,000 at $4,700.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 15, 3:08 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 10

Bijan Robinson, ATL vs KC ($8,200)

Bijan Robinson carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 25.5 DraftKings points at $8,200, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 4.5 points clear of Christian McCaffrey. The model gives him 21.0 carries and 4.8 targets. The salary works out to 3.11 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 23 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 25.4 points with a simulated floor of 13.3 and a ceiling of 42.7, and he holds 25% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 3-point underdog at home against Kansas City, with an implied team total of 22.25 in a game totaled at 47.5.

Christian McCaffrey, SF at DAL ($8,500)

Christian McCaffrey projects 2nd at the position with 21.0 DraftKings points at $8,500, 4th on the main slate overall. The model gives him 13.0 carries and 5.2 targets. The salary works out to 2.47 projected points per $1,000, 9th of 23 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations McCaffrey averaged 20.8 points with a simulated floor of 8.8 and a ceiling of 38.7, and he holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 4.5-point favorite on the road against Dallas, with an implied team total of 30 in a game totaled at 55.5.

Chuba Hubbard, CAR at NO ($7,200)

Chuba Hubbard projects 3rd at the position with 20.8 DraftKings points at $7,200, 5th on the main slate overall. The model gives him 18.6 carries and 3.6 targets. The salary works out to 2.89 projected points per $1,000, 3rd of 23 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Hubbard averaged 20.7 points with a simulated floor of 8.8 and a ceiling of 38.3, and he holds 25% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Carolina is a 1.5-point underdog on the road against New Orleans, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Value: Emmett Johnson, KC at ATL ($4,700)

Emmett Johnson projects for 20.8 DraftKings points at $4,700, which works out to 4.42 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 23 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 20.0 carries and 4.6 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Johnson averaged 20.5 points with a simulated floor of 8.7 and a ceiling of 38.5, and he holds 54% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 3-point favorite on the road against Atlanta, with an implied team total of 25.25 in a game totaled at 47.5.
